how_to_apply: Apply only online on the departmental website https://upanganwadibharti.in within the prescribed period.
Fill the application on the format available on the website correctly and carefully.
Upload clean and legible self-attested copies of all documents mentioned in the online form.
Offline applications, documents by post or by hand are not accepted in any case.
Last date for online application is 24-11-2026 up to midnight 12:00.
important_instructions: Gram sabha / ward-wise vacancy details are pasted on notice boards of Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, tehsil and block offices and uploaded on the website. Reservation is fixed for OBC and SC only; none for EWS, Divyang or freedom fighter dependants. The number of advertised vacancies may be reduced. Candidature is cancelled if any fact, data or marks are found wrong or forged. More information is available at the block CDPO office or the DPO office at Vikas Bhawan on office days.

Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The post is honorarium-based (maandey adharit); the notice prints no amount. Honorarium-based service. Service of a working Anganwadi Worker ends automatically from the oath date if she is elected as a panchayat or urban body representative. Service is ended at once if, after selection, she leaves her original village or lives elsewhere, including after marriage.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Programme Officer, Budaun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Programme Officer, Budaun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 391 vacancies for Anganwadi Worker.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Programme Officer, Budaun Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years (as on 1 July 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium-based post; amount not printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum Intermediate or equivalent. Merit is prepared on the basis of educational qualification up to postgraduate as the maximum.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only women candidates are eligible. Applicant must be a permanent resident of the ward / gram sabha of the vacant post. Two women of the same family will not be appointed as Anganwadi Worker and Helper at one Anganwadi Centre.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Male candidates.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit list prepared on the basis of educational qualification, minimum Intermediate or equivalent and maximum postgraduate. Merit prepared on the basis of educational qualification from Intermediate or equivalent up to postgraduate.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium-based service. Service of a working Anganwadi Worker ends automatically from the oath date if she is elected as a panchayat or urban body representative. Service is ended at once if, after selection, she leaves her original village or lives elsewhere, including after marriage.
